analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue for the first time with significant increases in EBITDA and profit after tax. The growth was driven by the commissioning of a new 1,10,200 TPA Alu-Zinc coating line in June 2025, capacity augmentation of the existing colour-coating line, and a strategic shift towards value-added coated steel products. The company maintained a conservative balance sheet with no long-term debt and announced forward plans including a new colour-coating line and a cold-rolling mill to further expand capacity and revenue. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial performance and operational updates for the fiscal year 2024-25 in its annual report.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme comprises an investment of Rs 40 Crore to add a new colour coating manufacturing line, enhancing manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 from 7.61% in FY 2023-24 on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported its highest EBITDA in existence at H48.07 Cr in FY 2023-24, which was almost twice that of the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company reported H48.07 Cr in EBITDA in FY 2023-24, the highest in its existence and almost twice that in the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Cold-rolled sheets and coils contributed 16.06% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: Widely used in industries like automobiles, home appliances, hot-dipped galvanized steel and pre-painted steel products, they contributed 16.06% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

orders_capacity.claim: Hot-dipped galvanized steel contributed 39.75% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company specialises in manufacturing hot-dipped galvanized steel for the building materials, white goods and electronic appliance industries, contributing 39.75% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

orders_capacity.claim: The pre-painted profile sheets segment contributed 41.88% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: This segment contributed 41.88% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated Rs 16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review, which was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review. This was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that a decline in sales growth on both standalone and consolidated levels failed to offset global market challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, decline in sales growth in standalone as well as consolidated levels, has failed to offset the challenges posed by the global market conditions.

management_commitments.claim: The colour coating expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
